weaknesses: The central interpretation is overstated. The domain-general claim is premature. The Shepard circles experiment is exploratory, uses only Gemini, lacks human comparison and quantitative IB-style evaluation, and therefore cannot strongly support generalization beyond color.

Reproducibility is incomplete: code is promised only upon publication, proprietary Gemini versions may shift, and some implementation details for controlled decoding, tokenization of labels, seeds, and prompt sensitivity are not specified enough for full replication.
